name: NexBuy
description: A trusted peer-to-peer (C2C) marketplace for Bangladesh with NID verification, anti-scam alerts, and secure local trading.

paragraphs: NexBuy is a verified peer-to-peer (C2C) classifieds marketplace designed specifically for Bangladesh to eliminate online fraud and advance-fee scams in the second-hand trading ecosystem. By incorporating a mandatory National ID (NID) and phone verification layer, NexBuy establishes an accountable, scam-free environment to browse, chat, and trade locally with peace of mind.
features: 🆔 Dual NID & Phone Verification: Mandatory identity verification for both buyers and sellers before posting ads or starting negotiations.
🛡️ Anti-Scam Shield & Real-Time Alerts: In-app safety banners and warnings that alert users against advance payments, off-platform communications, and fraudulent transactions.
📍 Hyper-Local BD Location Filtering: Structured filtering by Bangladesh administrative divisions, districts, and local sub-areas (Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, etc.).
💬 Secure Messaging & Click-to-Call: Integrated communication channels with scam prevention prompts and masked phone contact options.
📊 Seller Analytics Dashboard: Manage active listings, track customer inquiries, view verification statuses, and monitor ad performance.
